notes: Daytona 1000, Quota 1000, California 1100 i.e., California III from 1993. Outside the 25-year window for most owners and only partially supported by the open tools. Read-only identification here. Live local identifiers for this family have not been captured yet. Run the read-only identifier discovery scan and contribute the result; until then the workstation offers identification, DTCs and raw discovery only.

memory.write_blocked_reason: No reader or writer exists for this family anywhere in the GuzziDiag toolchain, and no memory-access sequence has been captured. These are early-1990s ECUs whose maps generally live in a socketed EPROM, so the practical route is to pull the chip and use an EPROM programmer.
